description: This file contains implementation of autograd profiling functions related to recording function scopes, including entering and exiting record functions, handling futures, and registering related operators in the PyTorch JIT compiler.

classes.name: _RecordFunction
classes.description: A class representing a profiling record function used for autograd profiling.

methods.name: record_function_enter
methods.description: Creates a new profiling scope using RecordFunction and invokes its starting callbacks.

methods.name: record_function_enter_legacy
methods.description: Legacy signature for entering a record function, returns a tensor handle.

methods.name: record_function_enter_new
methods.description: Creates a new PythonRecordFunction and starts profiling.

methods.name: getRecordFunctionFromTensor
methods.description: Retrieves a RecordFunction reference from a tensor handle.

methods.name: record_function_exit
methods.description: Ends the profiling scope created with record_function_enter.

methods.name: record_function_exit_legacy
methods.description: Legacy signature for exiting a record function using a tensor handle.

methods.name: _call_end_callbacks_on_fut
methods.description: Template function that attaches profiling end callbacks to a future.

methods.name: _call_end_callbacks_on_fut_legacy
methods.description: Legacy signature for attaching profiling callbacks to a future using a tensor handle.

methods.name: _call_end_callbacks_on_fut_new
methods.description: Attaches profiling end callbacks to a future for a PythonRecordFunction.
